commits.messageBody:
Match the client helpers by retaining strlen results and the lowercase copy index as size_t. This removes uint narrowing on LP64; it does not change allocation failure policy or the existing tolower input contract.

(cherry picked from commit c98f2a6dca7794ec8a2f1705208b2796f25c981f)
commits.messageHeadline: foundation: keep duplicated string lengths at host size

commits.messageBody:
Use size_t for strlen results and the tag-building loop index. Preserve character conversion, byte order, and the existing first-four-character behavior with space padding.

Matching client header was compiled by native v120 Win32/x64 Debug consumers and produces the same 4,098 sampled tags as stock on both architectures. This does not validate arbitrary oversized inputs or the full server.

(cherry picked from commit c03e4a1a72c3f5daff8501907e4bfc70e1919fa1)
commits.messageHeadline: foundation: retain native string lengths in tag conversion
